analysis: Reviewed ProviderLoop+Serve.swift (head 1-613) and ProviderLoop+StartupPreload.swift (base 1-545 plus patch @@301). Changes: (1) Serve.swift:497 adds selectedModelRecovery.attempt?.task to the shutdown preload-cancel set, which tightens teardown by cancelling background recovery loads before the drain and unload. (2) Serve.swift:523 replaces the inline unload loop with unloadAllModelsForShutdown(), whose body is not supplied. It must preserve the old semantics: wait for modelsUnloading, unload every slot, and skip persistLoadedModelSet during shutdown. (3) StartupPreload.swift head ~304-310 enqueues selected-model recovery for candidates skipped or failed for memory and for candidates not attempted. The enqueue is guarded by !Task.isCancelled, !isShuttingDown and !startupPreloadStopRequested, but not by !servingDrain.refusing. The adjacent updateAggregateCapacity guard at base 307 does check servingDrain.refusing. Integration must confirm that ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery honors the add-on hold model-load fence (TB-012/T-059/A-018) before loading. Otherwise a recovery load could run beside sandbox VMs or while admission is closed. Integration must also confirm that recovery loads go through ensureModelLoaded with the retirement checks: advertisedModels membership and isRefusedByRetirement/failedSelfTestHashes (base 476-479). A model retired after a failed self-test must not be reloaded or re-advertised. Self-test-failed ids are not in the enqueued lists, but a race with retirement is possible. No change to attestation, App Attest connection control, key handling (A-003), encryption or cache-scope plumbing (T-041) was observed in these units. The registration and attestation paths are unchanged. These units show no concrete regression, but the recovery implementation is outside the supplied evidence.
